views.label: Flag evaluation path
views.note: The app SDK evaluates flags against the flagd sidecar over localhost:8013 inside the same pod.

views.label: Flag sync from CRD
views.note: The sidecar watches the FeatureFlag custom resource and picks up changes without a redeploy.

views.label: Sidecar injection
views.note: The OpenFeature Operator's mutating webhook adds the flagd container when the pod annotation is present.

cards.title: Sidecar mode
items: Lowest latency: app talks to flagd over localhost
One flagd per pod; failures are isolated per pod
Scales together with the application pods

cards.title: Configuration
items: Injected automatically via the Operator pod annotation
flagd reads flags from the FeatureFlag CR and syncs on change
